name: - swapX
fix_description: Function 0x4f1f05bc accepts a user-supplied from address parameter and calls transferFrom without validating that msg.sender == from. Attacker passes victim addresses as the from parameter to drain their approved tokens. Fix: validate that from == msg.sender, or remove the from parameter and always use msg.sender.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a straightforward allowance-abuse drain: it iterates over victims, uses an existing approval to pull BUSD via a vulnerable swap function, then dumps the received token. It requires little protocol-specific DeFi reasoning, no flash loans or complex state manipulation, and the exploit flow is only a couple of external interactions.
